تعتقدوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِدُوا (taʕtaqidū) /taʕ.ta.qi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# تُعْتَقَدُوا (tuʕtaqadū) /tuʕ.ta.qa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
